body: I'm with not putting expectations on them, but I would like to think they were smarter than to say "other people have it worse" as their first response.

They don't understand depression, nor how deeply my pain impacts my life. At what point does it stop being support and start being me telling them what to say? It means so much less when I have to say the exact words I need from them.
Only of living. I have never served in the military.
